component.name: RPM Installer
component.summary: Install local RPM files through dnf5daemon

description.p: A small libadwaita desktop app that installs local RPM files from Nautilus using dnf5daemon authorization and transaction APIs.
Switched desktop integration to the system themed RPM icon for cleaner icon consistency.
Polished application metadata while keeping the same stable app ID.
Added relation-colored status headings and an uninstall action for already-installed packages, with continued stability hardening.
